fact: INS Cameroon published the Adamaoua regional statistical yearbook, 2025 edition, on 7 August 2026, compiling statistics from sectoral administrations, local authorities and enterprises across 22 chapters; its regional agencies produce one every year.
system: Annuaire statistique de la région de l'Adamaoua, édition 2025

fact: The INS report on civil-registration statistics 2018-2022, published August 2023 (the dates 2018-2022 are the years its figures cover), draws on civil-registration centre records for 2018 and on health-information (DHIS2) data for 2018-2022, alongside the 2018 demographic and health survey.
system: Rapport sur les statistiques de l'état civil au Cameroun (2018-2022), first edition

fact: The INS, with BUNEC and the Ministry of Public Health, published the first edition of the report on civil-registration statistics in August 2023, covering 2018-2022; many key tables are left partly or wholly empty for lack of data.
system: Rapport sur les statistiques de l'état civil au Cameroun (2018-2022), first edition
